verdict.rationale: SES exposes a fully documented public API (SendEmail, API v2 reference) plus SDK and SMTP interfaces, with extensive first-party API reference docs and community confirmation of building programmatic integrations (e.g., Lambda-based inbound processing). Missing for 10: no independent verification of a machine-readable OpenAPI/spec file (probe found 404s) and no explicit mention of API rate-limit/versioning docs for agentic automation.
